description: Pembrolizumab is recommended, within its marketing authorisation, as an option with chemotherapy for neoadjuvant treatment and then continued alone as adjuvant treatment after surgery for adults with triple-negative early breast cancer at high risk of recurrence or locally advanced breast cancer. It is recommended only if the company provides pembrolizumab according to the commercial arrangement.
